object: perching-and-takeoff robot with electroadhesive smart adhesive
problem: How to enable dynamic perching on moving and wet or dry surfaces with a self-sensing, impact-resistant, contact-adaptable adhesive robot
mechanism_or_method: Discrete-pillar attachment structures with sandwich artificial muscles for adhesion switching plus an integrated pressure and deformation sensor
limitation: Lab demonstrations only; limited payload and surface variety and no field flight evidence stated
decision_relevance: Supports adhesive-based perching designs for drones to save onboard energy

problem: How to make hydrogels self-stiffen or self-soften on demand under mechanical stretching
mechanism_or_method: Genetically engineered thrombin-hirudin pair coupled to the network; stretching disrupts inhibition and switches on catalysis
limitation: Proof of concept only; requires engineered proteins and specific substrates, scalability unclear

object: molecular sieving adsorbent for olefin/paraffin separation
problem: How to sieve multiple C2-C4 olefins from paraffins in one adsorbent to obtain pure ethylene
mechanism_or_method: Flexible layered Cu coordination material whose interlayer spaces open selectively through stronger olefin C=C host-guest interactions
limitation: Lab-scale breakthrough tests; stability, cost and scale-up not demonstrated

problem: Can highly connected nia-topology 3D COFs be synthesized and used to separate benzene from cyclohexane
mechanism_or_method: Planar hexagonal and triangular-prism nodes to build nia nets; adsorption, breakthrough tests and DFT analysis
limitation: Modest separation factor of 2.02; lab-scale only

object: redox-active isoindigo sorbents for electrochemical carbon capture
problem: How to break the scaling between redox potential and CO2 binding affinity in electrochemically mediated carbon capture sorbents
mechanism_or_method: Intramolecular hydrogen bonding in isoindigo derivatives shifts redox potential by over 350 mV without weakening CO2 binding
limitation: Molecular-scale demonstration; system-level energy efficiency and long-term stability not established

object: 2D MOF nanosheet membranes for hydrogen sieving
problem: How to control stacking modes of MOF nanosheets to tune effective aperture for precise H2 separation
mechanism_or_method: Linker polarity regulation promotes AB stacking, shrinking effective aperture to 0.372 nm, supported by calculations and permeation tests
limitation: Lab membranes only; scale-up and long-term stability under mixed gases not shown

problem: How to retain high porosity in melt-quenched MOF glasses for gas separation membranes
mechanism_or_method: Topological engineering of ZIF precursors with large 12-membered ring pores, then melt-quenching into self-supported membranes
limitation: Moderate CO2/N2 selectivity of 14.8; lab-scale membranes

problem: How does Nb content change lattice structure and passivation film to improve corrosion resistance
mechanism_or_method: Vacuum arc melted single-phase BCC alloys; Nb reduces {011} spacing and drives layered passivation film via uphill and downhill diffusion
limitation: Laboratory corrosion tests on small ingots; extreme-environment performance not validated
decision_relevance: Guides Nb content selection in corrosion-resistant alloy design

problem: How to achieve one-way elastic wave routing in a three-port system without breaking reciprocity
mechanism_or_method: Wave-vector modulation in a linear passive structure producing perfect mode transition and wave trapping
limitation: Demonstrated on a specific lab structure; applicability to other frequencies and geometries untested
decision_relevance: Offers passive wave isolation and routing design for elastic devices

problem: How to raise operational dimensionality of soft robots with few actuators and control signals
mechanism_or_method: Actively adjusting and synthesizing interior electromagnetic vectors in each flux actuator sub-domain under passive magnetic fields
limitation: Needs external magnetic field setup; demonstrated at lab scale only

problem: How to build materials with self-tunable conductivity and stiffness for robotic compliance and protection
mechanism_or_method: Field's metal embedded in elastomer gives strain-sensitive conductivity and Joule-heating-driven stiffness change
limitation: Lab prototypes only; fatigue life and thermal cycling not addressed in abstract
decision_relevance: Enables self-triggered compliance compensators for robot manipulators

problem: How to give synthetic materials ultrasensitive, durable mechanosensing comparable to living cells
mechanism_or_method: Dinoflagellates embedded in 3D-printed double-network hydrogels with hydrophobic coatings, plus a mathematical model of luminescence versus stress
limitation: Living organism maintenance; lifetime about 5 months, lab conditions only

object: liquid crystalline elastomer with isomerizable network topology
problem: How to program and alter actuation onset temperature of LCEs after synthesis in space and time
mechanism_or_method: Two distinct transesterification pathways in aromatic and aliphatic esters, spatially controlled by a photo-latent catalyst
limitation: Specific ester-containing LCE chemistry; actuation fatigue and response speed not discussed

problem: Was there a detectable multi-month seismic preparation phase before the Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaras earthquake
mechanism_or_method: Catalog analysis of spatio-temporal clusters, inter-event statistics, Gutenberg-Richter b-values and quiescence near the epicentre
limitation: Single retrospective event; precursory interpretation not prospectively validated
decision_relevance: May inform earthquake monitoring design and precursor recognition

object: flexible 1D coordination polymer adsorbent for C6 cyclic hydrocarbons
problem: How to completely separate benzene, cyclohexene and cyclohexane using adsorption instead of distillation
mechanism_or_method: Temperature- and adsorbate-dependent molecular sieving with reversible structural transformation, probed by in situ infrared and ab initio calculations
limitation: Lab-scale adsorption tests; industrial cycling and scale-up not shown

problem: Can landslide movement types be identified from topological properties of their 3D shapes
mechanism_or_method: Topological analysis of landslide 3D shape from elevation data to classify slides, flows and falls, validated across five regions
limitation: 80-94% accuracy depends on available inventories and elevation data quality
decision_relevance: Improves landslide movement labeling for hazard model inputs and risk evaluation

problem: How to make transformable high-density 3D soft coils for actuation, sensing and communication
mechanism_or_method: Fabrication of high-density liquid metal channels in elastomer surpassing enameled-wire density, applied to actuators and sensors
limitation: Lab prototypes; reliability and leakage of liquid metal under cycling not stated

object: amine-mediated electrochemical CO2 reduction in integrated capture and utilization
problem: How do amine structure and electrode material determine reaction pathways in integrated CO2 capture and reduction
mechanism_or_method: In situ spectroscopy of MEA and AMP on Cu and Pb electrodes to identify carbamate strength and proton shuttling roles
limitation: Limited to two amines and two electrodes under lab conditions

object: solid-state electrolyte membranes for lithium extraction
problem: Can solid-state ion transport give near-infinite Li selectivity in aqueous lithium extraction
mechanism_or_method: Anhydrous hopping of Li ions through ordered solid-state electrolyte lattice with size and charge exclusion
limitation: Low Li flux and stability in real brines not addressed in abstract

problem: How to tailor local atomic ensembles in HEA catalysts for improved ethanol oxidation
mechanism_or_method: Sequential pulsed annealing forms ultrafine PdSn clusters within a PdSnFeCoNi HEA matrix
limitation: Stability tested only to 2000 cycles; noble metal content and scalability

problem: How to make ceramics both tough and strong up to 1300 C
mechanism_or_method: Contiguous network of plastic Cr7C3 phase within a high-entropy carbide hard phase, toughening via shear bands, bridging and deflection
limitation: Small specimens; fracture toughness 12.5 MPa m^1/2 and long-term high-temperature durability not assessed
decision_relevance: Informs ceramic selection for components serving up to 1300 C

problem: How to build processible framework membranes with precise size and charge sieving of molecules, nanoparticles and proteins
mechanism_or_method: 2D supramolecular framework from organic host-guest motifs and polyanionic clusters, tuned by solvent modulation
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; mechanical durability and scale-up not discussed

object: passive cooling unit for photovoltaic cells
problem: How to cool PV cells passively and reversibly to raise power efficiency
mechanism_or_method: Zeolite 13X water desorption plus NH4NO3 dissolution endothermic cooling on cell backside, recovering at night
limitation: Long-term cyclic stability and humidity dependence not established; cost analysis based on assumptions
decision_relevance: Supports adding sorption-based passive cooling layers to PV modules

object: multi-layer protective coatings under erosive wear
problem: How to monitor erosive wear of coatings in real time and non-destructively
mechanism_or_method: Microwave differential split ring resonator sensors under coating with embedded circuitry and recurrent neural network predicting wear depth
limitation: Validated in lab erosion tests up to 2.5 mm; field durability untested
decision_relevance: Enables condition-based coating maintenance on blades and marine structures

object: elastocaloric air cooler with NiTi wires
problem: How to achieve continuous, efficient elastocaloric cooling with low driving force
mechanism_or_method: Coil-bending of NiTi ribbons and wires giving large heat transfer area and constant cold zone
limitation: Temperature drop only 10.6 K; fatigue life of NiTi under continuous bending not stated
decision_relevance: Favors bending-mode over uniaxial loading in elastocaloric cooler designs

object: melt electrowritten liquid crystal elastomer actuators
problem: How to fabricate complex 3D LCE microstructures across scales for actuators and temperature sensing
mechanism_or_method: Melt electrowriting of LCE fibers with controlled parameters, plus deep learning for temperature field sensing
limitation: Modest work density of 160 J/kg; lab-scale sensing grid

problem: Can defect scattering in a nanoscale heating zone enhance thermal conductance
mechanism_or_method: Molecular dynamics and Boltzmann transport equation show defects redirect overpopulated oblique phonons, restoring directional equilibrium
limitation: Purely computational; no experimental verification stated
decision_relevance: Suggests defect engineering to improve nanoscale heat dissipation

problem: How do individual elements govern oxide growth and composition inversion during oxidation of a high-entropy alloy
mechanism_or_method: In situ atom probe tomography, TEM and XANES tracking oxide evolution in controlled oxygen
limitation: Single model alloy in controlled oxygen at limited conditions
decision_relevance: Guides element choice for oxidation-resistant alloy design

problem: How to combine high speed, efficiency and maneuverability in a soft swimmer with simple actuation
mechanism_or_method: Monostable flapping wing with pneumatic snap-through down stroke and spontaneous elastic snap-back up stroke
limitation: Tethered pneumatic supply and tank tests only
decision_relevance: Supports snap-through wings for simple, fast soft underwater robots

problem: How to resolve the trade-off between damping and mechanical strength across a broad temperature range
mechanism_or_method: Diffusion-controlled surface cross-linking creating a stiff armor on a high-damping polymer-fluid gel core
limitation: Fluid leakage and aging over long service not addressed in abstract
decision_relevance: Enables damping materials for impact protection from -45 to 135 C

problem: How to balance water transport and heat localization in solar desalination evaporators
mechanism_or_method: Monolayer membrane with arrayed macropores on one side and dense nanopores on the other for directional water transport
limitation: Outdoor tests short; long-term fouling and large-scale manufacture not shown

object: light-adaptive solar steam evaporator with spiropyran
problem: How to keep high evaporation rates while discharging salt without accumulation
mechanism_or_method: Spiropyran-modified wood bilayer whose light-driven structural change gates water for dynamic salt discharge
limitation: Relies on light variation for gating; outdoor durability beyond short tests unclear

problem: What structural feature governs liquid fragility at the glass transition
mechanism_or_method: Neutron diffraction and in situ high-temperature scattering relating average medium-range distance and unstable small rings to fragility
limitation: Correlation limited to a series of aluminosilicate compositions; causality inferred

problem: How to enhance homogeneous plastic flow in metallic glasses by chemical rather than topological heterogeneity
mechanism_or_method: Ti-Zr-Nb-Si and Mg-Zn-Ca based chemically distinct nanodomains with dynamic atomic intermixing at interfaces
limitation: Small-scale films or specimens; tensile behavior and scalability less demonstrated

problem: How can the interfibrous interface be designed to strengthen and toughen Bouligand structural materials
mechanism_or_method: Moderately aligned networked bacterial cellulose nanofibers forming interlocking and hydrogen-bond bridging interfaces
limitation: Single material system demonstrated; humidity effects and scale-up unaddressed

problem: How to deliver wireless biphasic deep brain stimulation with biocompatible lead-free ultrasound implants
mechanism_or_method: Two lead-free porous 1-3 piezoelectric composite elements on flexible PCB driven by dual-frequency external transducer
limitation: Tested in rodent epilepsy model only; human translation untested

problem: How to raise solar evaporation rate and salt tolerance with dynamic solar-tracking structures
mechanism_or_method: Kirigami-cut composite hydrogel membrane that reconfigures into 3D conical arrays by uniaxial stretching to follow the sun
limitation: Tracking relies on manual or external stretching; outdoor long-term operation not shown

object: US electric vehicle critical mineral supply chains
problem: How much do critical mineral bottlenecks limit EV deployment under new tailpipe standards and what are the emissions consequences
mechanism_or_method: Supply chain constraint and lifecycle emissions scenario analysis of mineral reserves and production capacities for 2027-2032
limitation: Depends on scenario assumptions about reserves, allies and production capacity
decision_relevance: Highlights graphite and cobalt supply as constraints for EV standards compliance

problem: How does shell-based Schwarz P topology affect fracture resistance compared to octet truss lattices
mechanism_or_method: In situ fracture experiments plus finite element simulations on Schwarz P minimal surface lattices
limitation: Limited to one shell topology versus octet truss and one base material
decision_relevance: Favors shell-based lattices for damage-tolerant lightweight structures

object: nickel-rich layered cathodes in Li-ion cells
problem: Can Ni/Li antisite disorder in aged cathodes be reversed noninvasively to restore capacity
mechanism_or_method: Magneto-electrochemical activation switches Ni3+ high-spin to low-spin, reducing super-exchange and letting Ni return to the TM layer
limitation: Demonstrated on one cell chemistry and an 8 Ah pouch cell; practical field rejuvenation unproven
decision_relevance: May enable upcycling of aged Ni-rich Li-ion cells instead of replacement

problem: How does multiscale structure control mechanical properties in biomimetic hydrogels
mechanism_or_method: Bottom-up self-assembly of physically crosslinked micelles forming oriented micrometer pores along fiber direction
limitation: Very low modulus below 1 kPa; limited to one polymer system

problem: How to design Bouligand-type structures resisting impact over a wide range of loading velocities
mechanism_or_method: Double-twisted Bouligand with gradient composition printed from PLA and TPU, tested experimentally and by finite element simulation
limitation: Polymer 3D-printed demonstrator; high-velocity behavior of engineering materials untested
decision_relevance: Guides layered protective structure design for multi-velocity impact

object: aramid nanofiber/boron nitride thermal management films
problem: How to raise both in-plane and through-plane thermal conductivity of layered films for electronics cooling
mechanism_or_method: Honeycomb-gel densification forming zigzag continuous interlayer phonon bridges
limitation: Lab films; long-term thermal cycling and interface contact in devices not detailed
decision_relevance: Supports use of bridged layered films for heat spreading and subambient cooling

problem: How to raise rotation output and fuel economy of miniature Marangoni rotors
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric porosity thermoresponsive hydrogel with drag-reducing profile and low surface tension anesthetic metabolite fuel
limitation: Fuel-limited operation at liquid surfaces; small-scale demonstrations

object: paraffin-graphene solar-thermal storage with optical waveguide
problem: How to speed up solar-thermal charging of low-conductivity phase change materials
mechanism_or_method: Side-glowing optical waveguide fibers deliver sunlight inside the composite, avoiding surface overheating
limitation: Outdoor test limited to one device scale; long-term cycling not stated
decision_relevance: Favors internal light delivery over surface irradiation for solar thermal storage

problem: Can metals reach high thermoelectric performance via interband scattering
mechanism_or_method: Electron-hole selective scattering of Au s electrons into localized Ni d states yields large Seebeck and power factor of 34 mW/m/K^2
limitation: Metastable Ni-Au system and high Au cost limit practical use

problem: How to give membranes self-cleaning ability against fouling without chemical cleaning
mechanism_or_method: Stimuli-responsive organic crystals on the membrane surface actuate mechanically upon mild heating to remove foulants
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; heating requirement and long-term crystal durability unclear

problem: How to overcome the cohesion versus interfacial adhesion trade-off in adhesives
mechanism_or_method: Initiator-free spontaneous polymerization of a protic ionic liquid monomer during solvent evaporation, forming entangled in situ adhesive layers
limitation: Requires heating and evaporation to cure; humidity and long-term bond durability not stated

object: steel pipelines under combined bending, axial force and pressure
problem: How to predict failure pressure of intact pipelines under complex coupled loading
mechanism_or_method: Limit state equation based on unified yield criterion with a 3D pipeline stress model, compared against failure data
limitation: Applies to intact pipelines; corrosion defects and dynamic loads not covered
decision_relevance: Guides yield criterion choice for pipeline failure pressure assessment

problem: How to close the gap between graphene fiber properties and those of individual graphene sheets
mechanism_or_method: Wet-spinning with aromatic amine linker forming covalent aromatic amide bridges between graphene edges
limitation: Fiber performance still below theoretical graphene values; scale-up asserted but not shown

object: ferrous medium-entropy alloy with Cu and Al
problem: How to strengthen alloys without losing ductility by spinodal decomposition
mechanism_or_method: One-step aging produces nanoscale periodic spinodal decomposition giving spinodal hardening beyond precipitation strengthening
limitation: Single alloy system; fatigue and high-temperature stability of spinodal structure not addressed
decision_relevance: Suggests spinodal aging as a route to strong ductile alloys

problem: How to build fast, programmable hydrogel actuators that work in harsh solvents
mechanism_or_method: Directional freezing-assisted polymerization in an anisotropic laminar scaffold gives lamellar cellular structure with aligned nanopillars
limitation: Lab demonstrations in vials or tanks; load-bearing force output not stated

object: skin-interfaced human-machine interface for drone control
problem: How to give drone operators intuitive gesture control with multimodal tactile and force feedback
mechanism_or_method: Stretchable skin-integrated sensing, tactile actuator array and neuromuscular electrical stimulation feedback in a closed loop
limitation: Small-scale human trials; long-term comfort and generalization across users not stated

object: Methionine@Fe3O4 nanoparticles for CO2 hydrate-type capture
problem: How to speed water-cage crystallization kinetics and raise CO2 capture capacity
mechanism_or_method: Magnetic nanoparticles with hydrophobic amino acids order local water and provide nucleation sites for hydrogen-bonded cage crystallization
limitation: Lab-scale capture tests; energy cost and scale-up for industry not demonstrated

problem: How to eliminate mechanical hysteresis in soft strain sensors under large, fast deformation
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial coordination with dual-network universal bonding material joining hyperelastic and hydrogel-dielectric layers, plus strain-rate-dependent evaluation
limitation: Tested up to 50% per second strain rate on lab specimens; long-term environmental stability unclear

object: thermal safety systems for skin-interfaced electronics
problem: How to automatically prevent skin burns when wearable devices overheat
mechanism_or_method: Thin bladders of low-boiling liquid vaporize to form insulating layer and delaminate the device from skin
limitation: Single-use style activation and tests on benchtop or models rather than long clinical use
decision_relevance: Adds passive fail-safe design option for wearable skin-contact devices

problem: What complex crystal structures explain unidentified phases of lithium near its melting minimum
mechanism_or_method: Crystal structure search combined with machine-learning potentials to explore the energy landscape up to 192-atom cells
limitation: Predicted structures not experimentally confirmed; only energetic competitiveness shown

problem: How to handle ultrasoft, ultrathin and ultraheavy objects with a single soft gripper
mechanism_or_method: Angle-programmed tendril-like grasping trajectories designed with experiments, theory and simulation
limitation: Lab object handling demonstrations; unstructured field operation not tested
decision_relevance: Supports trajectory-programmed soft grippers for delicate and heavy handling tasks

object: femtosecond-laser Janus membrane with mode switching
problem: How to keep Janus membrane unidirectional water transport durable against abrasion and clogging
mechanism_or_method: Stretch-to-open and release-to-close micropore-microgroove channels made by femtosecond laser that protect in situ
limitation: Requires stretching actuation and femtosecond laser fabrication; field durability limited to short tests

problem: How to reconcile rigidity, floppiness and multistability in one metamaterial by reprogramming zero modes
mechanism_or_method: Selective activation of metahinges via self-contact switches architecture between stiff, floppy and multistable states
limitation: Lab-scale prototypes; scalability and fatigue of metahinges not addressed
